mesh_scope: Compact integration example; domain and mesh convergence have not been established.
assumption: 0.2 m effective duricrust based on Warner et al. (2022); 3 m sandy-regolith base and 13 m blocky-ejecta base are reference interfaces, consistent with Hobiger et al. (2021) Table 1. The centimetre-scale loose surface layer is omitted. The domain may end within the blocky ejecta.
material_scope: Finite continuum regions; not grain-scale mixing. Rock/soil internal interfaces bonded.
site_scope: Western Elysium Planitia, InSight landing site: literature-based shallow reference stratigraphy with effective material properties and idealized sharp interfaces.
